CHROMIUM: supports set advertising intervals This patch supports a new dbus method to set advertising intervals. The advertising inervals are sent through a new mgmt method with the opcode MGMT_OP_SET_ADVERTISING_INTERVALS to bluetooth kernel subsystem. CQ-DEPEND=CL:386697 BUG=chromium:602461 TEST=Emerge and cros deploy bluez to a remote DUT. Scp test/test-advertising-intervals to the DUT. Scp test/example-advertisement to the DUT. Perform the following steps to verify advertising intervals. Open a terminal on the DUT, and execute $ btmon Open another terminal on the DUT, and register an advertisement. $ ./example-advertisement Observe that the default intervals are 1280 msec in btmon log. < HCI Command: LE Set Advertising Parameters (0x08|0x0006) plen 15 Min advertising interval: 1280.000 msec (0x0800) Max advertising interval: 1280.000 msec (0x0800) Press ctrl-c to terminate the advertisement. Set new intervals to 200 ms. $ ./test-advertising-intervals 200 200 It would show the following line in btmon log. = bluetoothd: Set Advertising Intervals: 0x0140, 0x0140 You could also use the btmgmt tool to see the new settings as $ btmgmt info current settings: powered bondable ... le secure-conn advertising-intervals Register an advertisement again. $ ./example-advertisement Observe that the new intervals bcome 200 msec in btmon log. < HCI Command: LE Set Advertising Parameters (0x08|0x0006) plen 15 Min advertising interval: 200.000 msec (0x0140) Max advertising interval: 200.000 msec (0x0140) Press ctrl-c to terminate the advertisement. Change-Id: I2115d54379728c773720149d9a3f6cf769bd94fb Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/386577 Commit-Ready: Shyh-In Hwang <josephsih@chromium.org> Tested-by: Shyh-In Hwang <josephsih@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Miao-chen Chou <mcchou@chromium.org>
